item.title: OCCRP Anti-Crime & Corruption Hero Award
item.description: The inaugural Anti-Crime & Corruption Hero award honors individuals confronting organized crime and corruption head-on — often at great personal risk.

item.title: Eastern Europe’s Synthetic Drug Network Dismantled in Major Raids
item.description: Coordinated raids in Ukraine, Poland and Moldova dismantled 36 synthetic drug labs, seized millions of doses and arrested more than 100 suspects in one of Eastern Europe’s largest crackdowns on synthetic cathinones.

item.title: Uzbek Mining Giant Defends $200M in Tenders to Secretive Firms, Silent on Other OCCRP Findings
item.description: Uzbekistan’s state-owned Almalyk Mining Metallurgical Complex defends over $200 million in foreign tenders after an OCCRP investigation found firms with hidden owners, false financial filings, and disputed signatures, raising concerns about transparency and oversight.

item.description: Cambodia: Over 48,000 Scammers Deported amid Scam Center Crackdown

item.title: Russian Woman Who Drunk-Texted FBI Agent Pleads to Spying for FSB
item.description: Nomma Zarubina heading U.S. prison for spying for Russian intelligence after a few tumultuous months in which her bail was revoked for harassing an investigator on her case.

item.title: Probe Shows Kyiv Prosecutor Linked to Unregistered Home
item.description: The family of a senior official in the Kyiv City Prosecutor’s Office has been linked to the acquisition of property worth more than $1 million, much of it registered to his 74-year-old mother, including land purchased below market value in a gated suburb of Kyiv where satellite imagery shows buildings that do not appear in official registries.

item.title: Newly Released Epstein Records Detail Financial Ties Linking Billionaire, Art Adviser and Epstein
item.description: Newly released files detail how Jeffrey Epstein managed finances for an art adviser who received $2.5 million from billionaire Leon Black, highlighting complex money flows that concerned accountants but show no criminal wrongdoing.

item.title: Corruption Case Sparks Street Clashes and Political Showdown in Albania
item.description: Demonstrators clash with police while demanding the government resign over charges against the deputy prime minister.

item.title: Slovakia Marks 8 Years Since the Murder of Journalist Ján Kuciak and his Fiancée
item.description: Slovaks are still waiting for justice. A retrial ordered by the Supreme Court of Slovakia is to reveal who masterminded the 2018 assassination.
